title: McCleary Museum

services.name: Displays and Exhibits
services.desc: Step back in time and explore the unique history of our community! Located in a stunning 1926 historic building-once a bustling Methodist church -the McCleary Museum & Event Center is our town’s biggest artifact and a must-see destination. Whether you are a history buff or just curious about local life, our exhibits offer something for everyone: The Timber Capital: Since our beginning, McCleary has been a timber town. See the massive saws, vintage tools, and heavy equipment that built our local industry. Legends and Lore: Meet the famous residents of our past, including Primo and Major Mite (the tallest and shortest men to live here), and learn the wild stories of the McCleary Moonshine

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: As a local nonprofit, our mission is simple: to make affordable, local access to diverse cultural, historical, and artistic programs a reality for everyone in McCleary and beyond. The Event Center at the McCleary Museum is a welcoming space where families gather for live music, students attend educational programs, and neighbors come together to celebrate and learn. In addition to our youth and adult programming, we offer our versatile event center spaces for community use via a donation-based rental.
